mapper.select: SELECT id, region, hash, old_text, new_text, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_ber_asis_tobe_pair WHERE region = #{region} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, region, hash, old_text, new_text, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_ber_asis_tobe_pair ORDER BY region, updated_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, region, hash, old_text, new_text, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_ber_asis_tobe_pair WHERE region = #{region} AND hash = #{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_ber_asis_tobe_pair ( region, hash, old_text, new_text ) VALUES ( #{region}, #{hash}, #{oldText}, #{newText} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE old_text = VALUES(old_text), new_text = VALUES(new_text)
